#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264ac: valid lines where case is no case: a case) pattern label, an array's first word, an argument after
# $(…) or after a starter word that is itself an argument; and a (case …) subshell.
out="$(
  case "$cmd" in
    case) echo c ;;
    *) echo d ;;
  esac
)"
echo "$out"
n=$(words=(case when); echo "${#words[@]}")
echo "$n"
msg="$(printf '%s %s' $(id -u) case)"
echo "$msg"
os="$( (case $1 in a) echo a ;; esac) )"
echo "$os"
w=$(echo if case of need)
v=$(echo time -p case in point)
echo "$w $v"
